_doc: Player-facing changelog for Tumblefair, newest first (shared/whats-new.js reads it). Append one entry at EVERY publish: plain language, what players will notice, no file names. `id` is stable and unique (date, plus a letter for a second publish that day).

entries.title: 42 new minigames and a livelier board
items: 42 new minigames, including: basketball (Hoop Frenzy, Court Clash, Letter Shot), Dirt Dash, Wizard Duel, Tower Pull, Castle Archers, Fair Darts, Pizza Pronto, Wagon Trail, Hide & Peek, Tilt & Lance, Floor Is Lava, Flood Rush, Claw Machine, Steady Hand, Shell Shuffle, Monster Rampage and Night of the Shamblers.
10 new Halloween games (October only), built on your favourites — Patchwork Pal, Cauldron Bobbing, Shifty Portraits, Pumpkin Fling, Coffin Cart Rally and more.
Fair games: Bumper Boats, Downhill Derby, Pie Toss, Ring Toss, Balloon Darts, Duck Derby, Water Balloon Ambush, Photo Booth and Sketchy Copy.
More memory games: Carousel Recall, Gone Missing!, Pair Panic and Order Up!

The board game: live events everyone plays — a real Dice Duel, High Striker, Shell Game, Steal or Share, Tomato Toss, Fortune Teller — plus prize cards, a shortcut toll, a cannon and quicker turns. The scores and results no longer cover the board.
Your favourite games got more variety (new rinks, tracks, themes and pictures), and the least-liked ones were rebuilt to be simpler.
✨ New and 🔧 Updated tags show which games just arrived or changed.
Screens are tidier on phones: name tags don't pile up, the connection dot moved into the ☰ menu, and the odd one out is always visible.
What's new: this list!

entries.title: New ways to play: Custom, Golf, and first to 100
items: Custom mode: no board and no vote — the host picks every minigame from the list and finishes whenever you like.
Golf mode: a round of golf, one hole after another.
Board games can be "First to 60 / 100 / 150 / 200 tickets" instead of a set number of rounds (a ribbon counts as 10).
Halloween mode: tick the box in the lobby to play only Halloween games. Unticked, they're mixed in while it's October.
One card in every vote is a ⭐ Top rated game, picked from everyone's 👍. The host can favour funny, competitive, teamwork, skill or relaxing games.
New 👍/👎 reasons that say what kind of fun it was, or what went wrong.
Filter the minigame list by kind: memory, racing, golf, fishing, boss fights and more.
Vote to remove a player, and the host's remove now keeps them out.
More time to read the rules: the game starts as soon as everyone taps "I'm ready".
My games: every minigame you've played, how many times, and what you thought of it.
Fixes: a clearer Long Drive, step-by-step Secret Architect, Two Truths now uses real facts, a fairer Safecracker, and the results screen says what each number means.
A tidier title screen.

entries.title: Accounts and fishing
items: Sign in (optional) to keep your coins, costumes and look on every phone — one account for every game on games.radgh.com. Scan a QR code to sign in with your phone.
Four fishing games: Reel Rumble, Pier Pressure, Net Gains and Glimmer Ice.

entries.title: Controllers, move cards and a tougher golem
items: Walk every menu with a game controller.
Move cards: hold 4 cards instead of rolling the die, or steal a mystery card from a rival.
Lobbies wait 5 minutes for a phone that fell asleep.
Pick clothes from a list in Change look.
Golem Smash: little rock critters to stomp, and a jump.

entries.title: Boss fights, ratings and Halloween
items: 20 new minigames, including co-op boss fights.
Rate every minigame 👍 or 👎 — it helps us make the fair better.
Public games: find a game to join from the title screen.
Halloween: spooky minigames, costumes and a haunted board all October.
The ☰ menu, Just watch, and Play instead.

entries.title: Dozens of new minigames and the Moonlit Pier
items: Over 50 minigames: races, brawls, boxing, dress-up and more.
A second board: the Moonlit Pier.
Smoother online play.
